notes.title: Major GunsBox VR Update: A New Era Begins!
notes.content: [p][b]Dear players[/b],[/p][p]We’ve been working non-stop to improve GunsBox VR and build something even more thrilling, fast-paced, and immersive. Today, we’re excited to unveil the biggest update in the game’s history![/p][p][/p][h2]🔧 What’s New:[/h2][p][/p][h3]💥 New Content:[/h3][p]We’ve added a ton of fresh gameplay content — including brand-new weapons, accessories, and tuning options to enhance your arsenal like never before.[/p][p][/p][h3]🎮 Graphics & Performance Boost:[/h3][p]Massive optimization efforts and graphical upgrades have been made across the board to bring you a smoother and more visually stunning experience.[/p][p][/p][h3]🖥 Complete UI Overhaul:[/h3][p]All in-game interfaces have been redesigned from the ground up, along with a fresh new look for the in-game store and item library.[/p][p][/p][h3]🏠 Introducing the New Armory:[/h3][p]Say hello to the all-new, fully functional Armory — complete with an integrated in-game shop to manage your gear and unlock new items effortlessly.[/p][p][/p][h3]💡 A New Chapter: Going [b]Free-to-Play[/b][/h3][p]As part of our evolution and vision for the future, GunsBox VR is officially becoming free-to-play from Aug 1. However, some of the previously available content will now be locked at launch for new players. These items — along with hundreds of exciting new functional additions — will be available as optional purchases.[/p][p]💎 [b]Good news for early supporters[/b]: All players from Early Access will retain all previously unlocked content. Thank you for being with us on this journey![/p][p][/p][h3]🚀 Entering Pre-Release Phase[/h3][p]We are now transitioning from Early Access into a pre-release version. This final stretch is about gathering your feedback, testing thoroughly, and applying final touches. The official release is planned next week, but our commitment doesn’t stop there — we’ll keep improving the game and delivering new content, including free updates for everyone.[/p][p][/p][h3]🙏 Thank You![/h3][p]Thank you for sticking with us, for your feedback, and your support. We invite you to join our Discord community — we’re always listening and ready to chat![/p][p]See you in the our Discord Channel, [url="https://discord.gg/dyW9dbxP2V"]https://discord.gg/dyW9dbxP2V[/url][/p][p]MadZone Team[/p]

notes.title: Update v.1.9.0 is here!
notes.content:
Hello [b]everyone[/b]!

Today we released a major update with a ton of new content. We haven't released so many new weapons in one update yet.

[h2]Beretta 92x PERFORMANCE[/h2]

The Beretta 92X PERFORMANCE is a high-performance pistol designed for competitive shooting and discerning enthusiasts. As an evolution of the iconic Beretta 92 series, this model incorporates advanced features to enhance accuracy, control, and overall shooting experience. Boasting a sleek and ergonomic design, the 92X PERFORMANCE features a steel frame, extended beavertail, and a Vertec-style grip for improved handling. The pistol is chambered in 9mm and is renowned for its smooth trigger pull, making it a favorite among competitive shooters seeking precision and reliability. With an adjustable rear sight, an oversized magazine release, and an extended magazine well, the Beretta 92X PERFORMANCE is tailored for those who demand top-tier performance in both speed and accuracy on the shooting range.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/tXt5drD/beretta-92x.gif[/img]

[h2]CZ Shadow 2 OR (2 modifications):[/h2]

The CZ Shadow 2 OR (Optics Ready) is a cutting-edge pistol designed for competitive shooting and tactical applications. Building on the success of its predecessor, the Shadow 2, this variant comes equipped with an optics-ready slide, allowing users to easily mount their preferred red dot sight for enhanced target acquisition and precision.

The CZ Shadow 2 OR features a sleek and ergonomic design, with a full-length dust cover and an extended beavertail for improved control and recoil management. The pistol is chambered in 9mm, offering a balance of power and manageable recoil for rapid and accurate follow-up shots. Its double-action/single-action trigger system provides a smooth and crisp pull, contributing to the pistol's reputation for accuracy.

Constructed with a steel frame, the CZ Shadow 2 OR is known for its durability and robust build. The oversized ambidextrous safety and extended magazine release make it user-friendly, especially in high-stakes shooting competitions. Whether used by competitive shooters or those in the tactical realm, the CZ Shadow 2 OR stands out as a reliable and high-performance firearm.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/286Yd8z/cz-shadow2-1.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/4Z8XDsZ/cz-shadow2-2.gif[/img]

[h2]Desert Eagle L5 357 Magnum:[/h2]

The Desert Eagle L5 in .357 Magnum is a powerful and iconic handgun, renowned for its striking design and impressive performance. Manufactured by Magnum Research, this particular variant of the Desert Eagle series stands out with its lightweight construction, featuring an aluminum frame that reduces overall weight without compromising on durability.

Chambered in the potent .357 Magnum caliber, the Desert Eagle L5 delivers a formidable combination of stopping power and accuracy. The pistol features a distinctive gas-operated, rotating bolt design, contributing to its reliable cycling and reduced recoil. The L5 model incorporates a 5-inch barrel, providing a balance between maneuverability and ballistic performance.

The handgun is equipped with a Picatinny rail on the barrel, allowing users to customize their firearm with various accessories such as optics or tactical lights. Its ergonomic grip and ambidextrous safety add to the overall user-friendly design, making the Desert Eagle L5 .357 Magnum a preferred choice for those seeking a blend of power, precision, and distinctive aesthetics in a semi-automatic handgun.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JnWMjXQ/desert.gif[/img]

[h2]Walther PPQ M2 Q5:[/h2]

The Walther PPQ M2 Q5 is a competition-ready pistol that combines precision engineering with ergonomic design to deliver exceptional performance on the shooting range. Crafted by the renowned German firearm manufacturer, Walther, the PPQ M2 Q5 is a variant of the PPQ series specifically optimized for competitive shooting.

Chambered in 9mm, the PPQ M2 Q5 features a 5-inch barrel, providing an extended sight radius for improved accuracy. The pistol boasts a match-grade, quick-defense trigger known for its short reset and crisp break, enhancing both speed and control during rapid-fire sequences. The slide is optics-ready, allowing users to easily mount their preferred red dot sight for enhanced target acquisition.

The ergonomic grip of the PPQ M2 Q5 incorporates interchangeable backstraps, ensuring a comfortable fit for various hand sizes. The gun's ambidextrous controls, including the magazine release and slide stop, contribute to its user-friendly design. With a durable polymer frame and a matte finish, the Walther PPQ M2 Q5 not only excels in competition but also stands out as a reliable and aesthetically pleasing firearm for enthusiasts and professional shooters alike.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/D5jnWdg/walter-ppq.gif[/img]

[h2]FN Five Seven MK2 (2 modifications):[/h2]

The FN Five Seven MK2 is a highly distinctive and advanced semi-automatic pistol designed and manufactured by FN Herstal. Renowned for its unique features, this handgun is chambered in the proprietary 5.7x28mm caliber, delivering a combination of low recoil and impressive muzzle velocity.

The FN Five Seven MK2 features a polymer frame, contributing to its lightweight design, and is equipped with an ambidextrous safety and magazine release for user convenience. The ergonomic grip, coupled with the textured surface, ensures a secure and comfortable hold during firing.

One of the standout characteristics of the Five Seven MK2 is its high-capacity magazine, capable of holding up to 20 rounds. The pistol's accuracy is enhanced by its fixed three-dot sights, and the gun is optics-ready, allowing users to mount various sight systems for improved targeting.

Known for its use by military and law enforcement agencies worldwide, the FN Five Seven MK2 is recognized for its reliability, advanced engineering, and the unique combination of features that set it apart in the realm of modern handguns. Whether for professional use or as a firearm enthusiast's choice, the FN Five Seven MK2 offers a distinctive and powerful shooting experience.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/G3cqrhr/fn57-1.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/b2wWm9v/fn57-2.gif[/img]

[h2]SIG Sauer P320 (2 modifications):[/h2]

The SIG Sauer P320 is a versatile and modular striker-fired pistol known for its reliability, accuracy, and adoption by military and law enforcement agencies. This polymer-framed handgun is designed to accommodate a wide range of users with its modular design, allowing easy customization of grip size and caliber.

Featuring a striker-fired system, the P320 delivers a consistent and crisp trigger pull. The unique characteristic of the P320 lies in its ability to swap out the entire firearm's core (chassis), enabling users to change grip frames, barrel lengths, and calibers without requiring a new firearm. This modularity makes it adaptable to various roles, from personal defense to professional duty use.

The P320 is available in multiple sizes, including full-size, compact, and subcompact, catering to different preferences and needs. Its ergonomic design, combined with the optional integrated accessory rail, makes it suitable for attaching lights or lasers.

Known for its reliability and accuracy, the SIG Sauer P320 has gained widespread popularity among civilian gun owners as well. The firearm's adoption by military services reflects its performance and adaptability, making it a go-to choice for those seeking a reliable, modular, and accurate handgun.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/PTRwVq4/p320-1.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/rvfvYZy/p320-2.gif[/img]

As always ou can find out more in our Discord - https://discord.gg/8VyDbubxM7


Enjoy :)

notes.title: Patch v.1.8.1 is here!
notes.content:
Hello [b]everyone[/b]!

It's been a long time since we wrote to you or released updates. This is all because the whole team is implementing a large content part, which will bring a new experience to the gameplay based on our engine. You can already see some spoilers on our [url=https://discord.gg/8VyDbubxM7]Discord[/url] channel. Well, we will publish more details later when we can show you all the charms of the new game modes. 

We need to update the game engine to implement all the ideas we have conceived. Therefore, we have updated the Unity game engine from version [b]2020[/b] to [b]Unity 2022[/b]. This will give us many new opportunities in the future but also cause many problems after the migration. We have successfully fixed all the issues found. But maybe some little things have leaked out. Let us know in the Discord if you find any shortcomings, and we will promptly fix them.

Thank you for staying with us!

notes.title: Update v.1.4.0 is available!
notes.content:
Hi all!

In today's update, we have implemented two new features: new game mode - [b]3-GUN[/b] and moving [b]car[/b].

[b]3-GUN[/b] is an action-packed multi-gun competition that trains speed and accuracy. Players use three different firearms — a modern sporting rifle, a pistol and a shotgun. Three gun simulates combat or self-defense situations.

Now you can design your own stages not only for IPSС or Steel Challenge, but also for 3-GUN mode

We have also implemented a [b]car[/b], by adding it to the stage you will be able to practice your shooting while moving. Due to the peculiarities of the implementation, it can only be used in the "teleport" movement mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41642892/5bb01231e5d6e297300c39a57a2625c2b07cb614.gif[/img]

Currently we are busy preparing a major update that will allow users to create their own maps and share them with all players. We are in the final phase and will soon show you the result.

You can find out more in our Discord - https://discord.gg/8VyDbubxM7

See you soon!

notes.title: Update v.1.1.0 is available!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We are excited to announce that v.1.1.0 uploaded to Steam)

The most essential things implemented are [b]the locomotion system with smooth turn[/b] (check input settings in the menu) and new [b]weapon control schema[/b]:
[list]
[*] The locomotion system supports movement speed selection: running (gun down), walking and aiming, crouching, aiming while crouching.
[*] To charge the pistol, use the pinch action (trigger button) instead of grip action.
[/list]
The release notes and issues fixed in this update are as shown below.

[h1]Changelog - Update v.1.1.0[/h1]

[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Weapon Interaction areas size and positions adjusted
[*] Weapon control schema changed - pinch to charge the gun, grip to hold/grab the gun
[*] Locomotion system implemented
[*] Fault Lines implemented, existing stages updated
[*] Level Editor: Menu navigation improved
[*] Pistol handling improved (WIP)
[*] Destructible objects integrated
[*] Lobby Scene: inventory bench moved to the shooting area, optimization, interactable objects, drawers, doors
[*] Gun Club Scene: updated to support locomotion
[*] Hand animation support implemented
[*] Haptic while shooting implemented
[*] German localization added
[*] MP446 and Glock mags updated
[*] Valentine's day gift :)
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Magazine reload delay fixed
[*] Double-barreled shotgun fixed
[*] Pump Action shotgun operation fixed
[*] Inventory bench snap zone fixed
[*] Sniper scopes fixed
[*] Revolver sounds fixed
[/list]

[h2]WIP:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Inventory System
[*] OPEN GUN 2011
[*] IPSC tutorial
[/list]

And again, thanks to all of you for your ideas, bug reports, and patience))
Cheers!
